hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Competent tech demo with deliberate Tableau10 palette and clean control bar, but the 900px SVG is cropped in the viewport (bottom circles cut off), bundling edges are invisible in default Pack view, and the depth-opacity nesting reads more accidental than designed.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity — scaleSqrt correctly used for circle sizing in Force and Sunburst layouts, key functions present on node joins (d => d.data.id), data-driven scale domains throughout; bundle paths use index-based binding which is acceptable for anonymous connections.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view-at-a-time design avoids dashboard overload, 7-color palette stays within threshold with only 3-4 visually dominant in Pack view, and 85% edge bundling on 300 connections keeps link density manageable — animation quality (180+ nodes morphing simultaneously) cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
